answer: Every identity must cross a ridge of 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, with signed receipts, and post a 50 POA bond. A fake's vine of links stays narrow: its sockpuppets count as one cluster, so it must buy partners. Spot-checks strike like a gale; failure burns the bond. Forging 100 costs 5,000 POA in bonds plus 30,000 in fees, 35,000 against 20,000 of rewards: a loss near 15,000. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward whole.
